instruction: Enable the minimap feature in VS Code for the current user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the minimap feature in VS Code. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify 'editor.minimap.enabled' is set to true in the settings.json file. This is a simple single-setting configuration task with the same difficulty as the original.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: enabling VS Code minimap feature
Metric check_json_settings properly extracts expected dict from rules and compares with actual settings.json content
Getter get_vm_file correctly fetches /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json from VM (returns single string path when multi=False)
Complete coverage: instruction requires 'editor.minimap.enabled: true', evaluator checks exactly this setting
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 for missing file (None), invalid JSON (exception caught), or missing/incorrect setting value
No postconfig needed: VS Code settings.json persists after application closes

Static type warnings are false positives: metric implementation correctly treats 'expected' as Dict (accesses expected['expected']) despite misleading type annotation, and getter returns single string (not list) when multi=False

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
